label: UniFi Gate Starter Kit
description: UniFi Gate Starter Kit (UA-SK-Gate) - Gate Hub: 5x 1G RJ45 (1 PoE++ input, 4 PoE outputs at 30 W/port, 55 W aggregate). 22 W max without PoE output, 60 W with.

poe.note: Ubiquiti prints one row for the whole PoE side on https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/door-access/ua-sk-gate (HTTP 200, 726,929 B, read 2026-11-21): **(1) PoE++ input, 50V DC, 1A; (4) PoE outputs, 50V DC, 30W per port (Max 55W aggregated)**, with **Max. Power Consumption 22W (Without PoE output) / 60W (With PoE output)** and **Power Method PoE++**. 55 W is the PSE allocation shared by the 4 output jacks, not a per-port figure: four 30 W readers total 120 W, so the engine must refuse the last watt. The row says "PoE outputs" and not "PoE+", but 30 W per port at 50 V DC is 802.3at Type 2 and is modelled as such. **The vendor rows do not close on the input side**: 55 W of outputs plus 22 W of hub needs 77 W, while the inlet is 50 V x 1 A = 50 W and the kit ships a PoE++ adapter, and Ubiquiti itself prints 60 W as the ceiling "with PoE output". The printed 55 W aggregate is recorded as-is; the 77 W-vs-60 W gap is a question for the vendor, not a licence to lower the figure.

notes: Ubiquiti tech specs https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/door-access/ua-sk-gate (HTTP 200, 726,929 B, read 2026-11-21): **Networking Interface (5) 10/100/1000 Base-T**, **PoE Interface (1) PoE++ input, 50V DC, 1A; (4) PoE outputs, 50V DC, 30W per port (Max 55W aggregated)**, **Max. Power Consumption 22W (Without PoE output) / 60W (With PoE output)**, **Power Method PoE++**, **UL 294 Power-limited Class 2**. **This entry used to model the uplink as the PoE port**: eth0 declared `poeOut` class PoE++ and the four jacks a reader is actually cabled to declared nothing, so the spec advertised a 60 W source on the port that is fed *by* the switch and no source at all on the reader ports - and with no `poe.budgetW` the loader fell through to the model name, found no wattage and served 0 W (`node scripts/audit-poe-budget.js` listed this file under "Silent (PoE out, no budget)"). Direction now follows the same rows as the already-corrected `devices/ubiquiti/ua-g3-sk-gate.json` and `ua-hub-gate.json`: eth0 is the PoE++ PD input at 50 V x 1 A = 50 W, eth1-eth4 are 30 W PSE outputs behind the 55 W aggregate. The vendor prints 10/100/1000 Base-T, so every port carries the 10M rung. In the box: (1) Gate Hub, (1) Intercom, (1) PoE++ adapter, (2) 2-wire PoE extenders.
